references.text: The instructions for making the table of showbread and its utensils are given here, now completed in Exodus 39:36.
Bezalel made the table and all its utensils according to God's instructions.
Moses placed the table in the tabernacle and set the showbread on it.
The law concerning the showbread (לֶחֶם הַפָּנִים) that was to be placed on the table in the sanctuary.
Description of the table for the showbread and its utensils in connection with the Levites' service.
Solomon made the gold table on which the showbread was to be placed in the temple.
The priests set fresh showbread on the clean table every Sabbath as part of the service in the Lord's house.
The letter to the Hebrews mentions the table and the showbread as part of the furnishings and holy objects of the first tabernacle.
Instruction (chapter 35) and fulfillment (chapter 39) of the same building project.
Historical continuity: The table from Moses' tent is found again in Solomon's temple.
The instruction regarding 'always' (chapter 25) is confirmed in the completed execution (chapter 39).
